name: render-image-slim
title: Render image consolidation: drop dev-only Docker build context
description: Shrink the Render Docker image by excluding provably dev-only content from the build context: root materials/ (107M, never read at runtime), the 344M gitignored tools/ CSS baseline + Playwright harness, and .local/. .dockerignore does not respect .gitignore, so COPY . . currently ships ~450M+ of dev-only files. Planning-only; execution gated on maintainer approval.
